primary_marketing_principle: Lead with verified prospect-specific intelligence, not generic GovCon consulting claims.

front_door_offers.name: GSA Zero-Sales Diagnostic
front_door_offers.promise: Identify why the Schedule is not converting into measurable federal revenue and define the highest-priority corrective pathway.

front_door_offers.name: Federal Revenue Gap Analysis
front_door_offers.promise: Show where the company is currently positioned to win, where access is blocked, and which agencies, buyers, vehicles, or teaming paths deserve attention first.

front_door_offers.name: Recompete & Vehicle Growth Scan
front_door_offers.promise: Surface verified recompetes, incumbent exposure, vehicle gaps, and likely capture paths before the opportunity becomes a last-minute bid.

funnel: One high-value insight in outbound message
Proof/case study relevant to the pain

avoid: long service menus in first-touch outreach
asking for a meeting before giving a reason to care
mixing unrelated business-plan, grant, loan, website, or generic consulting positioning into core GovCon messaging
required_first_touch_elements: specific observed condition or verified data point
no more than one primary CTA

required_assets: 3 concise case studies organized by problem solved
outcome cards with verifiable before/after metrics
client quotes or references where permission exists
methodology explanation for ORION/P2GC intelligence without exposing proprietary internals
proof_system.rule: No quantified claim may be published unless source evidence is retained.

content_themes: what ORION finds in real market data
common reasons qualified contractors fail to convert registrations into revenue

outbound_experimentation.winner_rule: Promote messages based on downstream qualified meetings and revenue, not opens.

website_requirements: Homepage must state one clear economic outcome before explaining methodology.
Each front-door offer gets a dedicated landing page with one CTA.
Add a free Federal Pathway Score or equivalent diagnostic.
Move proof and outcomes above or adjacent to primary CTAs.
Remove or noindex legacy pages that dilute GovCon positioning.
Create a visible Insights/Intelligence section for recurring data-backed content.

sales_process.meeting_objective: Convert a verified diagnostic finding into a paid next-step engagement.

execution_order: Lock positioning and three front-door offers
Rewrite top-priority outbound around intelligence-first hooks
Create landing-page copy for each offer
Review competitor changes weekly and feed meaningful findings into experiments
